title: Square Base
description: Also called the preliminary base. Diagonals are valleys, book folds mountains.

steps.title: Diagonal crease
steps.instruction: Fold corner to corner, then unfold.
mistakes: A crease that misses the centre.

steps.title: Other diagonal
steps.instruction: Fold the other two corners together, then unfold.
tips: Both diagonals cross at the centre.

steps.title: Turn over
tips: Book folds go in from the back.
mistakes: Creasing book folds on the front.

steps.title: Book creases
steps.instruction: Crease both book folds, then unfold.

steps.title: Turn back
tips: Diagonals are valleys from this side.

steps.title: Collapse
steps.instruction: Bring all four corners down together.
tips: Let the creases guide you; do not force them.
mistakes: Collapsing into a triangle, which is the waterbomb.
steps.check: A small square with the open end down.
